input:
Thanks — also, can we set up a time to go over the latest reporting templates? I need to align them with our policyholders’ data.
The customer needs to schedule a meeting to review and align the latest reporting templates with policyholder data.

Lastly, our finance team’s pulling their hair out — the dashboard totals don’t match the CSV exports, causing export figures mismatch headaches.
Dashboard totals do not match CSV export numbers, causing confusion for the finance team.

when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims
Duplicate claims are created when a policyholder reports the same incident via multiple channels because the system fails to alert staff.

We’re keen to get our claims handlers trained up on the new workflow.
The team needs to train claims handlers on a new workflow.

When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims, which is a classic duplicate loss report scenario and causes confusion in reserves and reporting.
Duplicate loss reports are created when the same incident is reported through multiple channels because the system doesn't detect or link them.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with our suppliers’ invoices but can’t locate the matching documents in the system.
The user cannot find the documents that match a payment batch during reconciliation.

Looking forward to seeing how Keelwater handles our claims and supplier reporting needs.
The customer lacks a solution that effectively manages their claims and supplier reporting.

We need to assign clear roles and automate document routing — our current system doesn’t let us track tasks properly.
The team cannot assign clear roles or automate document routing, so tasks are not tracked properly.

That’s what we value most — a partner that listens.
We feel our current partners don’t listen to our needs.

can we automate letters for overdue claims? I’m swamped with manual drafting.
The customer has to manually draft letters for overdue claims, which is overwhelming.

same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it.
Duplicate claims are created when the same incident is reported through multiple channels, and the system provides no alert.

Could you walk me through how to assign tasks to specific roles for claims handling?
The user does not know how to assign tasks to specific roles in the claims handling process.

Hi Alwen, thanks for setting this up — we’ve been meaning to talk about how your platform’s recent interface tweaks are throwing off our team’s rhythm.
Recent interface changes are disrupting the team's workflow.

That’d be great — I’m not seeing the option under payments or tasks right now.
The user cannot locate the option to split a payment across multiple payees.

Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real ... delays and oversight risks.
Garage estimates are misfiled and require manual recategorization, leading to missed evidence and delays.

we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones.
Claims are being assigned to the motor team in a way that doesn't align with their workload or postcode zones.

we’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s ... holding up claims processing.
Multiple users are unable to log in, causing a delay in claims processing.

we’re really keen to get started with your system for handling claims and documents
The customer needs to begin using the claims and document handling system promptly.

That’d be great — I’ve got about twenty files to get in before the reserves report closes.
The user needs to submit many files quickly before a reporting deadline.

Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.
Garage estimate documents are misfiled, requiring manual correction and causing evidence to be missed.

Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
Handlers spend hours on the phone each day instead of processing claims or managing reserves.

I’m trying to pull the latest reporting for our policyholders but I can’t access the portal. I think I’ve lost my password.
The user cannot log into the portal because they have lost their password.

I’ve ruled out our own systems — it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug.
The error message is misleading, implying a Keelwater bug when the issue is actually a customer network failure.

We’ve been managing claims and documents manually for years, and it’s becoming unsustainable.
The company is handling claims and documents manually, which is no longer sustainable.

Perfect — that’ll help us evaluate whether this fits our claims handling model.
Uncertainty about how the solution aligns with their claims handling model.

We’re still waiting on the multiple file upload feature — right now I have to add each document individually, which takes ages when handling large claims with suppliers and policyholders.
Uploading documents one by one is time‑consuming for large claims.

We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.
Unannounced UI changes cause staff confusion and delays as they must relearn where everything is.

Could we schedule a quick call next Tuesday to walk through the new claims dashboard layout?
The customer needs assistance understanding the new claims dashboard layout.

are there any known issues with document uploads during high-volume claim periods?
Document uploads may fail during high-volume claim periods.

We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
They have to manually call each supplier to see garage repair progress, which interrupts their work.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5... Documents: click "Open"
The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type.

Appreciate the quick response. We need clarity before our next client review cycle.
The customer lacks sufficient clarity for the upcoming client review cycle.

Also, the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads to incorrect file type issues.
The document upload system misclassifies files, causing them to be placed in the wrong category and resulting in file type errors.

we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
The team lacks built‑in visibility of garage progress and must make phone calls to get updates.

we’re trying to pull a full report on outstanding claims and reserves but the system’s not showing updated supplier payments.
The system fails to display the latest supplier payments when generating reports.

We need to generate formal correspondence in letters in Welsh for our policyholders in Wales — it’s non‑negotiable for us.
The company must produce official letters in Welsh for policyholders, which they find mandatory.

It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.
Unexpected interface changes force staff to be retrained, wasting time and reducing accuracy.

We rely on clean claims and reporting, so this matters.
Their claims data is not clean, causing reporting difficulties.

We’re getting pushback from our high-value clients about the upcoming contract cost complaint — they’re asking why it’s gone up so much... they’re not happy with the renewal pricing and we’re getting pressure to justify it.
High-value clients are pushing back on the increased contract renewal cost and demanding justification.

Yes — we’re getting pushback from our finance team because the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file. It’s causing some trust ...
Report totals on the dashboard don't match the exported file, causing finance team pushback.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble accessing my account — I think I might need to reset my password. It’s been acting up since yesterday.
The customer cannot log in because they need to reset their password.

I need to schedule a recurring task for monthly reserves review — is that possible via the dashboard?
The user cannot set up a recurring task through the dashboard.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble locating the updated reserves after finalising a claim — can you help?
The user cannot find the updated reserves after finalizing a claim.

Actually, I can’t log in right now — I think I need a password reset to proceed with the claims documents.
The user cannot log in because they need a password reset.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The customer must provide policy documents in Welsh to meet renewal requirements.

We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.
Webhook retries are delayed, causing real‑time claim processing issues.

Appreciate it — that’s the key item for us.
The customer needs a specific item to be provided before renewal.

Perfect. And can we pull a report that shows all claims with pending letters and their associated policyholders in one view?
The user cannot easily obtain a combined view of pending‑letter claims and policyholder information.

That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?
The customer needs to understand how reserves and payments will integrate with their current accounting tools.

We’re still wrestling with the wrong document category issue — garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.
Garage estimate documents are automatically categorized incorrectly, requiring manual reclassification.

Hi Bryn, I’m Lirven from Calderwick Commercial — we’ve been using Keelwater for a few months now and I’ve got a quick question about claim notes.
The customer is unsure how to use claim notes in the platform.

We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up... Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.
Approvals for reserve changes get stuck when the designated approver is on leave and no delegate is configured, causing claim processing delays.

Unexpected interface changes keep shifting where we click for reserves or payments — our staff are making errors because the controls aren’t where they were last week.
Unexpected interface changes cause staff to click the wrong controls and make errors.

Correct, we need clarity there. Correct, we need clarity there.
The customer lacks clear information about the pricing details.

Tasks: click "Open"... Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
Users must repeatedly click Open and Save to view claim details, leading to frustration.

could you confirm if the reporting module pulls data from all active roles?
The customer is unsure whether the reporting module includes data from all active roles.

We need this fixed before the year-end claims surge.
The platform has an issue that must be resolved before the upcoming year‑end claims surge.

we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us...the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves.
Duplicate claims are created when the same loss is reported through multiple channels because the system provides no warning.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.
The team needs both automatic claim routing by postcode and workload, and manual routing control for complex cases, but the system lacks configurable per‑team routing options.

We’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s holding up claims processing — I’d appreciate any insight from your end.
Customers are unable to log in, causing delays in claims processing.

I’ve got a small request around document handling.
The customer wants an improvement to how documents are handled in the platform.

Appreciate the quick help — the integrations with our payment gateway are working smoothly now.
The customer was unable to get their payment gateway integrated correctly.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard this morning.
The user cannot log into the claims dashboard because they forgot their password.

Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard.
Finance cannot determine the correct figure because the exported report data differs from what the dashboard shows.
